name: cozystack-claude-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for the Cozystack ecosystem — deployment skills, development workflows, and infrastructure tools

plugins.name: cozy-deploy
plugins.description: Deploy a Cozystack package to a dev cluster via make + cozyhr — handles fresh install and dev-loop iteration with ExternalArtifact support

plugins.name: cozy-external-app
plugins.description: Scaffold a new Cozystack external app package — generates chart skeleton, ApplicationDefinition, and handles dependency integration (e.g. Immich → Postgres) via managed CNPG clusters or external secret references

plugins.name: drbd-recovery
plugins.description: Diagnose and recover DRBD/LINSTOR storage issues in Kubernetes clusters — handles StandAlone, DELETING, Inconsistent, Diskless, quorum loss, bitmap errors, and other common failure modes

plugins.name: cozystack-upgrade
plugins.description: Guided upgrade of a running Cozystack v1.x cluster to a newer v1.x patch or minor version — release-notes analysis, prechecks, stop gates, helm upgrade, targeted post-upgrade verification, known failure recovery

plugins.name: cozy-bump
plugins.description: Bump a cozystack monorepo package — reads upstream changelog between current and target versions, surfaces breaking changes / deprecations / new required keys, adapts values.yaml and templates, regenerates schema and ApplicationDefinition, runs helm template + lint, commits, and optionally deploys to a dev cluster via cozyhr suspend + make apply with ttl.sh ephemeral image registry
